He intentado buscar el Concept ID `1549080` en el modelo de datos OMOP, pero no he encontrado ningún concepto estándar con ese identificador. Es posible que sea un error tipográfico o un concepto no estándar.

Sin embargo, puedo proceder con los otros Concept IDs aprobados: `1586808`, `1586809`, `1586810`, que corresponden a "estrógenos conjugados sintéticos, B" y sus dosificaciones.

Aquí tienes la consulta SQL para BigQuery, calculando la proporción de tiempo de exposición a los estrógenos conjugados sobre el tiempo total de observación, manejando la división por cero:

```sql
SELECT
    p.person_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.total_drug_exposure_days), 0) AS total_drug_exposure_days,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_observation_days), 0) AS total_observation_days,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(SUM(o.total_observation_days), 0) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(d.total_drug_exposure_days), 0) * 100.0) / COALESCE(SUM(o.total_observation_days), 0)
    END AS proportion_exposed_percent
FROM
    person AS p
LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            de.person_id,
            CAST(SUM(DATE_DIFF(de.drug_era_end_date, de.drug_era_start_date, DAY)) AS BIGNUMERIC) AS total_drug_exposure_days
        FROM
            drug_era AS de
        WHERE
            de.drug_concept_id IN (1586808, 1586809, 1586810)
        GROUP BY
            de.person_id
    ) AS d
ON
    p.person_id = d.person_id
LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            op.person_id,
            CAST(SUM(DATE_DIFF(op.observation_period_end_date, op.observation_period_start_date, DAY)) AS BIGNUMERIC) AS total_observation_days
        FROM
            observation_period AS op
        GROUP BY
            op.person_id
    ) AS o
ON
    p.person_id = o.person_id
GROUP BY
    p.person_id
ORDER BY
    p.person_id;
```
